728-856-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

574-6528-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-6528-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1417-4279-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-4268.easyPrerequisites:

You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-4268.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

206-2034-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-3967-4871-7316.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2185-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-2185-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

457-1792-1796-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-1796-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Centaur Omenreader.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

791-2290-7315.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-7315.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

628-2034-7191.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

225-539-2908-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.
225-539-2908-3664.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

141-3440-5686.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

141-2034-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2034-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

104-2275-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

104-2086-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2523-5561.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1651-2557-2561-4559.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2781-4772-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2781-4772-5917.description:

When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

457-1409-3129.description:

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

3750-4050-4700-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other nontoken Dinosaurs.
An opponent cannot block Gishath.
3750-4050-4700-5220.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gishath.
Gishath triggers, causing you to reveal the top seven cards of your library and put all Dinosaurs revealed this way onto the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five other nontoken Dinosaurs, adding {3}{R}{R}.
When the Dinosaurs die, Mortuary triggers that many times, putting the Dinosaurs on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

4050-4690-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic lands.
4050-4690-4790.description:

When the Phylath token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing the Phylath token and five Plants, adding {6}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more basic lands, this combo nets infinite colorless mana and creature tokens.

Spark Double enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.

When Gilraen enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.

If you control one additional Human and/or Noble, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eyeblight Cullers, adding {1}.

Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Eyeblight Cullers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

220-413-3828.notablePrerequisites:

Deal damage to Brash Taunter.

Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing that much damage to target opponent.

The Squirrels enter the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing a Squirrel, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Quintorius and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
